name: io.github.adamsjack711-ux/pkgxray
title: pkgxray
description: Pre-install security scans for npm packages, MCP servers, and AI agents with cited verdict evidence.

tools.name: audit_agent_extension_supply_chain
tools.description: Statically inspect up to 16 KiB across 16 supplied source files. Does not download or execute packages. Results cover only the supplied evidence, not a verified package artifact. Never send credentials or private source without permission.

packageName.description: Optional package label for the report, such as express or @scope/package. This label does not trigger a package download or establish its identity; omitted labels use supplied-evidence.

sourceFiles.description: Map 1–16 file names to their literal source text, for example {"index.js":"module.exports = 42;"}. Names are report labels, not paths to read. File names and contents together must fit within 16 KiB of UTF-8 data. Include only source you are permitted to share, with credentials removed.

additionalProperties.description: Literal source text for the named file. It is inspected as data and never executed; the file map shares one 16 KiB UTF-8 budget.

tools.name: check_npm_package_metadata
tools.description: Check registry metadata and OSV advisories for one exact public npm version. Does not inspect package source, verify provenance, install or execute code. An advisory-free result is still REVIEW, not installation approval.

name.description: Public npm package name, such as express or @scope/package. Supply the name only, without a version suffix, registry URL, or local path.

version.description: Exact published npm version, such as 4.21.0. Semver prerelease and build suffixes are accepted; tags such as latest and version ranges such as ^4.0.0 are not.
